subject: Next steps: compliance scoping + vendor questionnaire kickoff (Aurora Health)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: compliance scoping + vendor questionnaire kickoff (Aurora Health)

Hi Liam — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can move the compliance conversation into a concrete plan: 

Call recap (high level)
- Aurora is focused on HIPAA workflows for patient-facing features and wants to understand Redwood's SOC 2 posture, GDPR data processing controls, and contract-level protections.
- Primary compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II report (recent), BAAs for PHI handling, data residency options, and retention/audit log capabilities.
- Aurora is also interested in a roadmap for adding ISO 27001 and exploring FedRAMP for potential future government work.

Immediate next steps (proposed)
1) Attach the vendor security questionnaire your team shared during the call — we will populate answers and return within 7 business days.
2) Share Redwood's current SOC 2 cover letter + compliance overview doc (attached).
3) Identify scope boundaries: which product endpoints will be in-scope (APIs handling PHI) — can you confirm the top two integrations?
4) Schedule a 45-minute technical intake with Aurora security + our security engineering team (suggest Wed 11/18 or Thu 11/19).

Action items for Aurora
- Confirm which Aurora environments (prod vs. staging) will be covered by the initial scoping.
- Share any specific regulatory evidence requirements beyond SOC (e.g., log retention windows, encryption-at-rest attestations).

I'll attach the questionnaire you mentioned and a draft SOW so procurement has a starting point. If those timelines look tight we can prioritize immediate evidence (SOC 2 cover letter, encryption, and BAA template) and follow with a broader certification roadmap (ISO, FedRAMP).

Thanks — kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
redwood.ai

Attachments: Aurora_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45kb); redwood-compliance-overview.pdf (pdf, 320kb); SOW-draft-Aurora-20261118.docx (docx, 38kb)

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@aurorahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com, security@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Next steps: compliance scoping + vendor questionnaire kickoff (Aurora Health)

Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the clear recap. Quick responses inline: 

> Identify scope boundaries: which product endpoints will be in-scope (APIs handling PHI) — can you confirm the top two integrations?

We plan to scope the following initially:
- Patient messaging API (ingests PHI: names, appointment details, limited notes)
- Claim submission helper (tokenized patient identifiers; no full EHR export)

Both live in our prod environment. We can include a read-only staging instance for validation but primary evidence needs to be prod.

Evidence & timeline
- SOC 2 Type II: we need the most recent report or bridge letter if the full report is delayed.
- BAA: yes, please send your standard BAA; our legal will redline.
- Log retention: minimum 1 year for security logs, 3 years for audit logs is preferred.

Question on FedRAMP: we are only exploring FedRAMP at this stage (no immediate requirement), but we'd like to see a high-level roadmap and whether Redwood has experience mapping controls to FedRAMP Moderate.

We're good for the technical intake on Wed 11/18 at 11am ET — invite to follow from our security team.

-Liam

On Tue, Nov 17, 2026 at 09:30 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time today — confirming we'll send the questionnaire and SOW by EOD.
>
> kim

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, security@aurorahealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: compliance scoping + vendor questionnaire kickoff (Aurora Health)

Liam — attaching the completed vendor questionnaire (draft) and the SOW for procurement to review. Highlights and clarifications below.

What we attached
- Aurora_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx — populated answers in green; open items flagged for Aurora security to confirm.
- redwood-compliance-overview.pdf — includes our SOC 2 Type II date (2026-06) and a short control mapping for PHI handling.
- SOW-draft-Aurora-20261118.docx — initial milestones, optional accelerated SOC evidence package, and pricing placeholder for dedicated support during onboarding.

Highlights / open items
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II in June 2026. We can provide the full report under NDA or a bridge letter if you need something faster.
- BAA: included as a draft clause in the SOW — legal teams typically redline within 7–10 business days.
- Log retention: our platform supports configurable retention per-tenant; default retention is 90 days. We can commit to a 1-year security log retention for the Aurora production tenant (contracted SLA + incremental storage fee).
- FedRAMP: we do not currently hold FedRAMP authorization. We have run control gap assessments against FedRAMP Moderate and can share a mapping worksheet; we propose a separate FedRAMP scoping engagement if Aurora wants to pursue authorization.

Next steps (action owners)
- Aurora security: review questionnaire open items + confirm prod/staging scoping (Liam). Target: 11/24.
- Redwood (Kim): share SOC 2 report under NDA by 11/20 if Aurora requests; otherwise share bridge letter and control mapping by 11/19.
- Redwood (Ben): prepare a high-level FedRAMP gap summary and a rough estimate for a scoping engagement by 11/30.
- Procurement (Aurora): review SOW and flag commercial questions — target redline by 11/29.

I've scheduled the technical intake for Wed 11/18 at 11am ET — invitation with the dial-in is below. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Kim

Kim / Monica — quick internal note after the Aurora thread and the technical intake this morning:

- Good signal on SOC 2 and willingness to contract for 1-year log retention.
- Procurement will likely push on pricing for extended retention & dedicated onboarding hours; SOW contains placeholders that we should firm up.
- Action: Monica, please draft a concise pricing carveout for 1-year retention + 24/7 incident support add-on. Include both monthly and one-time transition estimates.
- I'll prepare the FedRAMP gap summary and an estimated level-of-effort bucket (low/med/high) — deliverable by 11/30.

Also: recommend we offer Aurora a «compliance milestone» playbook (milestones: evidence delivery, BAA execution, SOC 2 control walkthrough, optional ISO/Gap engagement) as an attachment to the SOW so procurement sees a clear path. Monica, can you pull that from last quarter's playbook and adapt for Aurora? Target EOD 11/22 for inclusion in the SOW update.

Thanks — Ben
